added.title: Bend and Snap
added.instruction: Touch your toes and back up.
added.info: Increase your flexibility and boost circulation by touching your toes, and then returning to a standing position. This simple movement enhances mobility, reduces stiffness, and can provide a quick energy boost throughout the day.

added.title: Fuel Up
added.info: Nourish your body by eating something high in protein. This provides sustained energy, supports muscle health, and keeps you feeling full. It's an important part of a balanced diet, and can keep your physical performance at it's best.

added.title: Posture Police
added.info: Enhance your well-being and improve your posture by sitting up straight. This promotes spinal health, reduces discomfort, and makes you look more confident. Small changes to your position can make a big impact on health and appearance.

added.title: In and Out
added.info: Cultivate mindfulness and reduce stress by doing a 10-minute breathing exercise. This simple practice can center your mind, calm your nervous system, and improve focus. Taking the time for yourself can enhance your entire day.

added.title: Knead to Relax
added.info: Indulge in self-care and relieve tension by getting a massage. This therapeutic practice can reduce stress, ease muscle pain, and promote relaxation. It's a great way to look after both your mental and physical health.

added.title: Well-Done
added.info: Nourish your body by preparing a healthy meal. This promotes better nutrition, enhances your culinary skills, and provides a satisfying sense of accomplishment. Putting together a meal yourself can make a big impact on your wellbeing.

added.title: Liquid Loops
added.info: Stay hydrated throughout the day by refilling three water bottles. Proper hydration is essential for physical health, energy, and overall well-being. Making a habit of drinking water will benefit your body in so many ways.

added.title: Chasing Tails
added.info: Have fun and bond with your pet by playing a game. This is a great way to connect with animals, enjoy some light physical activity, and give your pet the attention they deserve. Moments of play can be very refreshing for you too.

added.title: Floodgates
added.info: Challenge yourself to drink a gallon of water to improve your hydration. This task increases awareness of your daily fluid intake, ensures your body gets the hydration it needs, and fosters a habit of drinking more water.

added.title: Peak Experience
added.info: Connect with nature, exercise, and experience breathtaking views by going for a hike. This is a great way to clear your mind and challenge your physical limits. There is always a new scenic trail waiting to be explored.

added.title: Standing Tall
added.info: Improve your physical health and appearance by maintaining perfect posture all day. This involves conscious awareness of how you sit, stand, and move. Small changes in your alignment can make a big difference to physical health.

added.title: Frame-able
added.info: Capture your unique perspective of the world by taking a beautiful photograph. This allows you to explore creativity and capture memorable moments from your daily experiences. See the world with a new lens.

added.title: Sheet Happens
added.info: Start your day with a tidy space by making your bed. This simple habit creates a more organized environment, and can influence a positive mindset. A small act of order makes a big difference.

added.title: Codebreaker
added.info: Challenge your coding skills and knowledge by completing 10 Leetcode medium level problems. This will improve your proficiency with algorithms and data structures. Consistent practice is the key to mastering new concepts.

added.title: Click to Begin
added.info: Expand your knowledge and learn new skills by beginning an online course. There are limitless avenues to explore. This is a valuable way to boost your knowledge and your career prospects too.

added.title: Endless Replay
added.info: Engage your creativity by making a looping GIF. Experiment with editing software, and learn about video and visual design. This fun, short format is sure to keep you engaged.

added.title: Who’s There?
added.info: Capture the unique characteristics of an owl by drawing it from an image or from memory. This creative task enhances your drawing skills, encourages observation, and explores a unique and interesting subject. There is so much you can see in one creature.

added.title: Peel Back
added.info: Enjoy a healthy snack and boost your energy by eating a banana. This provides essential nutrients, and the simplicity of this task means you can achieve a healthy break anytime. A simple food, that provides many benefits.

added.title: Golden Crunch
added.info: Explore a new cuisine by frying plantain chips. This provides an opportunity to learn new cooking techniques, and enjoy a unique and tasty snack. Experiencing a variety of food is a great way to discover the world.

added.title: Hen House Hustle
added.info: Connect with animals and contribute to the care of livestock by feeding chickens. This provides an opportunity to spend time outdoors, interact with farm animals, and gain a greater appreciation for the source of our food. It's a great chance to connect with nature too.

added.title: Cart Before the Horse
added.info: Engage with your entrepreneurial side and delve into the world of app development by starting the design process of an e-commerce application. This provides an opportunity to learn new skills, bring creative ideas to life, and potentially lead to a digital business venture.

added.title: Konk
added.info: Experience the process of obtaining a fresh coconut by plucking one from the tree or preparing it for consumption. This task connects you with food preparation and might give you an appreciation for the process of cultivating fresh ingredients. It's a great way to get in touch with nature.

added.title: Edge of Reason
added.info: Enhance your kitchen efficiency and safety by sharpening your knives. This ensures easier food preparation, allows you to maintain your tools, and promotes safer practices. A sharp knife is a chef's best tool.

added.title: Soot and Wonder
added.info: Maintain a clean and safe kitchen by cleaning your oven. This task can remove burnt residue and keep your appliance working efficiently and effectively. A well kept kitchen ensures a better environment for everyone in the household.

added.title: Palmreader
added.info: Capture the intricate details of a hand by sketching it on paper. This is a good drawing exercise to enhance your observation skills and practice your understanding of human anatomy. It can also be a creative and expressive project.

added.title: Under Control
added.info: Maintain your personal hygiene by washing your underwear. This essential task is important for cleanliness and is a key part of personal self care. Clean clothes also provide great comfort.

added.title: SELECT * FROM Start
added.info: Enter the world of databases and information management by learning the basics of SQL. This enhances your technical skill set and expands your knowledge of data management systems, which is essential for tech-related roles.

added.title: O(n)
added.info: Strengthen your coding and problem-solving skills by completing five Leetcode easy-level questions. This is a great way to practice fundamental concepts and algorithms in a structured and guided way. Practice is key to progress.

added.title: Custom Tags
added.info: Expand your web development toolkit by learning about web components. This technology allows you to create reusable UI elements, enhancing your ability to build modern and modular web applications. Web components allow for reusable code.

added.title: In Transit
added.info: Apply your web development skills by building a todo list app. This project will allow you to practice frontend and backend coding principles, and create a useful tool for task management. Learning by doing is the best path to growth.
